prompt: The manager told residents, “The roof terrace won’t reopen before Monday.” A crew member later said the railing should be finished by Sunday, but the manager would not give a date for the inspection. A resident planning a Monday gathering should understand the manager’s original statement as _____.
promptZh: 管理員告訴住戶：「屋頂露台在星期一之前不會重新開放。」工作人員後來說欄杆應可在星期日完工，但管理員沒有提供檢查日期。打算星期一聚會的住戶，應把管理員原先的說法理解為_____。

options.text: a commitment to reopen on Monday, provided the railing work finishes by Sunday
options.zh: 只要欄杆在星期日完工，就承諾星期一會重新開放
options.whyZh: 完工不等於已檢查；原句也沒有承諾星期一開放。

options.text: an assurance that Monday is the latest the terrace will remain closed
options.zh: 保證露台最晚只會關閉到星期一
options.whyZh: 「星期一之前不開放」給的是最早可能日期，並未設定最晚日期。

options.text: a limit on how early the terrace can reopen, not a guarantee that it will be open on Monday
options.zh: 界定露台最早可能何時開放，不保證星期一就能使用
options.whyZh: before Monday 的否定只排除星期一之前；星期一可能開放，但不是承諾，且檢查日期未公布。

options.text: a warning that reopening on Monday is impossible even if the railing work and inspection finish beforehand
options.zh: 即使欄杆和檢查都提前完成，星期一也不可能開放的警告
options.whyZh: before Monday 不包括星期一當天；這句無法推出星期一必定不能開放。

explanationZh: before Monday 的否定只排除星期一之前；星期一可能開放，但不是承諾，且檢查日期未公布。
evidence: won’t reopen before Monday / railing should be finished by Sunday / would not give a date for the inspection

vocabulary.note: 指屋頂上供人使用的開放平台，可用於描述住戶共用設施。
